scope: paired repair-only development evaluation; 2 historical and 6 developer-authored cases, not an independent benchmark

skillManifest.name: web-ui-acceptance-repair
skillManifest.description: Diagnose and repair generated HTML that fails a frozen browser interaction contract, including ambiguous targets, invalid action controls, and incorrect visible results.

S05.origin: new developer probe: listener lost after render

S06.origin: new developer probe: bubbling toggles twice

S08.origin: new developer probe: nested label text

order: case order S01..S08; baseline-first and skill-first alternate by case and repeat
